$description: NivoSense design tokens. Source of truth for T4.1: every token becomes a CSS variable named --<group>-<name> (e.g. color.ink -> --color-ink) and is mapped into Tailwind theme.extend. Format follows the W3C Design Tokens draft ($value, $type). Map data colours are not here: they live in ramps.json.

ink.$description: Pizarra (launa schist). Rail background, primary text, primary buttons. 16.4:1 on white.

on-ink.$description: Rail labels and icons at rest. 10.1:1 on ink.

on-ink-strong.$description: Rail label and icon of the active section.

accent.$description: Arrebol (alpenglow on the crest). Only for the active-rail bar, the selected basin outline and the timeline cursor. Never text on white (3.2:1); never in a data ramp. 5.1:1 on ink.

accent-text.$description: Accent when it must be text on white (5.1:1).

panel-soft.$description: Nevero. Grouped rows, inputs, skeletons, hover on white.

line-strong.$description: Borders that must be seen against panel-soft (form controls, empty swatches).

text-muted.$description: Secondary text, units, captions. 5.9:1 on white, 5.4:1 on panel-soft. The only grey for text.

focus.$description: 2 px focus ring with 2 px offset on light surfaces; on the rail the ring is on-ink-strong.

status-pending.$description: Pendiente: product planned but not produced yet. Dotted outline.

live.$description: Webcam live dot and 'En directo' text. 6.0:1 on white.

warning.$description: Stale data (older than the cadence promises). 5.9:1 on white.

danger.$description: Load errors only. An offline camera is a state, not an error: it uses text-muted. 6.2:1 on white.

map-halo.$description: Halo under map symbols and labels so they read over the L1C RGB and the light basemap.

body.$description: Inter (OFL), weights 400, 500, 600. Google Fonts or self-hosted.

display.$description: Source Serif 4 (OFL, Adobe), weight 600, optical size axis on. Panel titles, method page headings, the wordmark. Never below 20 px.

numbers.$description: font-feature-settings for every value, date and axis label, so digits align.

type.$description: Type scale. size/line-height in px. No text under 12 px anywhere. Letter-spacing 0 everywhere except display-xl (-0.01em). No all-caps text blocks.

caption.$description: Rail labels, legend labels, axis labels, timeline month labels, attribution.

small.$description: Row metadata (source, resolution, date), helper text.

lead.$description: Method page body, card big values.

eyebrow.$description: Panel eyebrow (section name), sentence case, colour text-muted.

value.$description: Headline numbers in basin cards, with tnum.

md.$description: Buttons, inputs, layer rows, rail buttons.

lg.$description: Cards, popovers, webcam card, timeline bar, bottom sheet top corners.

shadow.$description: Plain drop shadows only. No glow, no coloured shadows, no backdrop blur.

float.$description: Timeline bar, legend chip, map controls.

popover.$description: Info popover, webcam card, rail flyout.

play-frame.$description: Timeline play: one date per frame, waits for tiles before advancing.

reduced.$value: prefers-reduced-motion: every duration 0ms, play still steps but without cross-fade

rail-button.$description: Square hit area; icon 20 px plus 12 px label.

timeline-height.$description: Desktop timeline bar, bottom-centred over the map, max width 880 px, 16 px from the bottom.

map-control.$description: Zoom and compass buttons, top right.

breakpoint-mobile.$description: Below this: no rail column, bottom tab bar + bottom sheet.

sheet-peek.$description: Bottom sheet collapsed: handle, title and the timeline strip.

set.$value: Lucide 0.460.0 (ISC licence), lucide-react in the app

stroke.$value: 1.75px at every size (absoluteStrokeWidth), round caps and joins, no fills, currentColor

light.$value: IGN Base gris, https://www.ign.es/wmts/ign-base layer IGNBase-gris, GoogleMapsCompatible, image/jpeg
light.$description: Default. Attribution: '© Instituto Geográfico Nacional (IGN), CC BY 4.0 scne.es'.

ortho.$value: IGN PNOA orthophoto, https://www.ign.es/wmts/pnoa-ma layer OI.OrthoimageCoverage
ortho.$description: Optional detail basemap. Not the S2 L1C RGB, which is a data layer with a date.
